raw_text: From Grave to Death. As my 1998 collection of poems was entitled "Grave of an Amiable Child," this title naturally caught my eye. It's a well-meaning, idealistic attempt to make reading about (and remedying)deplorable urban conditions more immediate in the dramatic context of a mystery.
